description: This file defines the EmployeeTrackerController class, which is part of the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and primarily sets up a Vue component for employee tracking in the pre-render phase.

classes.name: EmployeeTrackerController
classes.description: Controller for managing employee tracker components, extending AbstractVueController to utilize Vue.js components within the OrangeHRM framework.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component before rendering by initializing the 'employee-trackers' Vue component.
